description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the pancreatic cancer detection feature (DetectPanc)
description_zh: 本文介绍胰腺癌检测DetectPanc的语法及示例
name: DetectPanc

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use Object Storage Service (OSS) URLs in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than Shanghai, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1, URLList.2.URL=url2, and so on. Separate parameter pairs with ampersands (&). Replace url1, url2, and other values with actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate the URLList
fields.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The type of the input data. Only `HTTP_FILES` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 输入数据的类型，仅支持`HTTP_FILES`
parameters.name: data_source_type

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain the data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Mask.description_en:
The URL of the lesion mask.

The URL is valid for 5 minutes. After the URL expires, you must regenerate it
Mask.description_zh:
病灶Mask地址。

有效时间为5分钟，5分钟后链接失效，需要重新生成

NonPdacVol.description_en: The non-pancreatic cancer lesion volume. Unit: cubic millimeters (mm³)
NonPdacVol.description_zh: 非胰腺癌病变体积，单位：立方毫米（mm³）

PancVol.description_en: The pancreatic volume. Unit: cubic millimeters (mm³)
PancVol.description_zh: 胰腺体积，单位：立方毫米（mm³）

PdacVol.description_en: The pancreatic cancer lesion volume. Unit: cubic millimeters (mm³)
PdacVol.description_zh: 胰腺癌病变体积，单位：立方毫米（mm³）

Possibilities.description_en: The probabilities of the three-class classification prediction, corresponding to normal pancreas, pancreatic cancer, and non-pancreatic cancer lesions, respectively. Value range: 0 to 1
Possibilities.description_zh: 三类分类预测的概率，依次对应正常胰腺、胰腺癌、非胰腺癌病变，取值范围0~1

items.description_en: The probabilities of the three-class classification prediction, corresponding to normal pancreas, pancreatic cancer, and non-pancreatic cancer lesions, respectively. Value range: 0 to 1
items.description_zh: 三类分类预测的概率，依次对应正常胰腺、胰腺癌、非胰腺癌病变，取值范围0~1

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
